outcome: Rate of severe thrombocytopenia as an indication for cesarean delivery
cohort: 129 pregnant women with thrombocytopenia of unknown causes
finding: Pregnant women with platelet counts below 50*10(9)/L, who were mostly primipara and often diagnosed early in pregnancy, experienced more complications and required closer monitoring but showed no significant difference in neonatal outcomes compared to those with higher platelet counts.
mod_finding: Patients with platelet counts below 50*10(9)/L had a higher proportion of severe thrombocytopenia as an indication for cesarean delivery.
